sets.description: The sets, by folder then base name.

items.description: A resource set: a neutral file and its culture files.

neutral.description: The neutral file (`Resources.resx`), the set's name everywhere.

folder.description: The folder, relative to the workspace folder (`.` for the workspace folder itself).

project.description: The project (its name as the Workspace window shows it) whose `EmbeddedResource` item the neutral file is; absent in a folder workspace or when the host does not list the file.

neutral_language.description: The project's `NeutralLanguage` property, the neutral column's label when known.

cultures.description: The set's cultures, the neutral file first (its `name` is the empty string), then by name.

items.description: One culture file of the set.

name.description: A culture name (`de`, `de-DE`, `sr-Latn-RS`), or the empty string for the neutral file.

missing.description: Keys of the neutral file with no value in this culture, invariant keys excluded (0 for the neutral file).

warnings.description: Cells of this culture with a rule warning.

strings.description: String entries in the neutral file.

non_strings.description: Non-string entries in the neutral file (files, images, WinForms designer state), listed read-only under Other Resources.

missing.description: Missing cells over every culture, invariant keys excluded.

designer.description: The generated code file beside it (`Resources.Designer.cs`), when one exists or the item's `LastGenOutput` names one.

access_modifier.description: The Access Modifier of the generated designer class: `internal` (ResXFileCodeGenerator), `public` (PublicResXFileCodeGenerator) or `none` (no code generation, no designer file).

source.description: `project`: listed by the host from the project's items; `folder`: found by walking the workspace (no host, or a file no project lists).

generation.description: The solution generation the host's list came from; absent without a host.
